title: 天皇賞（秋）の後に・自分を生きてこそ

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Running her own path in the coolest way she can, Vodka comes out on top in the fierce battle and wins the autumn Tenno Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: On stage, Vodka admits she would not have been victorious if it weren't for Daiwa Scarlet.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Vodka achieves her greatest glory by walking her own path, giving her an incomparable sense of accomplishment.
